ctx.x: Yes, anyhow I married Willard, and he came back to Chicago, back to the Dreamland. Well, Willard was such a nice fellow -- he was a perfect gentleman, a fine fellow -- he came back to Chicago with me. Lord, it's a shame the way I treated him. Came back to Chicago and he wanted -- the fellows around Chicago, you know, the ones that were in the sporting life, they wanted him to just hang around, you
know, and see me work, and I had never had that on my mind, you know.
